docs/cleanup/player-review/stage2/inventory-3-backend-bridge-loopback.md sections 4.1-4.5 (startSiloLoopback steps 1-11, startSiloLoopbackWriter 13 callback wirings, handleFirstSegmentReady, requestVODProducerRestart + coalescer, seek reanchor sites), 4.7 (teardown: the loopback half), 4.8 (essential vs glue), 3 (activeLoopbackSessionID/loopbackGeneration idioms)
brief:
WAVE-1 AS BUILT (use these names, not the design sketch): `PlaybackBackend` protocol = iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackBackend.swift (nonisolated protocol, AVPlayerBackend conforms via an extension at the end of AVPlayerBackend.swift; 17 callback closures + 3 providers are `{ get set }` requirements; `FakePlaybackBackend` in iosApp/Tests). `RecoveryPolicy.decide(_ observation: RecoveryObservation, context: RecoveryContext, now: Date) -> (action: RecoveryAction?, context: RecoveryContext)` in Screens/Player/Recovery/ (observations: startupTick(servedRequests:displayModeSwitchInProgress:), playheadTick(PlayheadSample), itemDeathEvidence(statusCode:description:weight:position:userPaused:), edgeSample(EdgeSample), playbackStalled, itemFailedToEnd(position:userPaused:), playlistUnchanged(userPaused:), likelyToKeepUp(rate:bufferedAhead:reachedEnd:likely:), seekDeadlineExpired(kind: SeekDeadlineKind), engineFailed(PlaybackFailure), originOutage(active:), sourceInterrupted(reason: PlaybackSourceInterruptionReason), sessionMissing(source: SessionMissingSource), serverHealthProbe(ok:), bufferingChanged(Bool); actions per RecoveryAction.swift: reassertPlay, nudgeStartup, reloadStartupItem, reanchor(atMediaSeconds:reason:), reloadItem(atMediaSeconds:reason:), restartProducer(atSegmentIndex:authoritative:), rebuildLocalSession(atMediaSeconds:reason:), deferUntilPlay(mediaSeconds:), resumePlayback, treatAsNaturalEnd, requestServerReplan(classification:message:), switchRoute(RouteFallback), renewSourceInBackground(reason:), renewSessionFresh(reason:), rideThroughOutage(probeAfter:), endOutageRideThrough(kick:), recoverFromServerOutage(reason:), waitForServerReady(probeAfter:), autoRecoverInterruption, fail(PlaybackFailure); `RecoveryContext` fields: route, playbackEstablished, userPaused, suspendedReasons, mediaTimelineOffset, startup?, playhead, itemDeath, itemDeathConfirmation, edge?, rebuildBudget, outage?, serverOutageRecovery?, backgroundRenewalTransientFailures, backgroundRenewalInFlight, freshRenewalInFlight, canRenewSourceInBackground, isProtocolV3Active, isReplanInFlight, hasWatchDetail, canAutoRecoverInterruption, attemptedNativeDirectFallback, attemptedLoopbackHLSFallback, canBuildLoopbackFallback, nearEnd?; `RecoveryContext.initial(route:)`; NOTE its `==` is reflection-based: never compare contexts on a hot path). `TrackSelectionCoordinator` (Screens/Player/Tracks/, NOT @MainActor) with `TrackSelectionPorts` whose `backend: () -> AVPlayerBackend?` must keep returning the live concrete backend; `PlaybackSessionBridge.init(transport:)`, `currentSessionId`, `stopSession(expectedSessionId:position:isPaused:)`; wave-1E control-plane types (LoadID, SessionIdentity, ExecutablePlan, PlaybackState family incl. EngineEvent/SessionEvent/TransportEvent/Effect) in Screens/Player/ControlPlane/ -- read their 'As built (wave 1E)' block in design section 2.3 before using them. Reviewer obligations carried from wave 1B for whoever wires the policy: (a) the startup ladder's stage lives in `context.startup` (non-nil while arming): do NOT clear it when the startup timer is cancelled if the `-15628` direct escalation (B:3499 at 20ba06b) can still fire before the file-loaded edge; (b) the policy's `waitForServerReady` issues one probe exactly at the 90 s boundary that legacy did not -- acceptable, documented in design section 7; (c) at outage entry, if the player is already buffering, emit `.bufferingChanged(true)` right after `.originOutage(active: true)` so the 'Reconnecting' notice logic (PVM:4290-4294 at 20ba06b) still fires.

WAVE 2a -- ONE package, behaviour-identical, backend-internal: extract the loopback lifecycle glue out of AVPlayerBackend into `LocalHLSHost`. No ladder changes, no VM changes, no policy wiring (that is wave 2b). The anchors in inventory-3 section 4 were taken at 20ba06b; AVPlayerBackend.swift has since gained only a 7-line conformance extension at EOF, so they are still valid -- re-grep anyway.

STEP 1. Create iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/Engine/LocalHLSHost.swift -- `@MainActor final class LocalHLSHost` (the backend's loopback members it replaces are touched from the main actor today; if any moved member is called from a non-main queue -- e.g. the server's vodSegmentMissResolver hops to main at B:2018-2026 -- keep that hop exactly where it is). Constructor takes what the moved code needs: `sessionSpec`, `sessionDirectory: URL` (derived as today from `<tmp>/silo-dv-hls-debug/<uuid>`), `keepArtifacts: Bool` (read ONCE from ProcessInfo `SILO_KEEP_DV_HLS` at init -- design section 7.2), the store memory budget / spill policy / VOD retention budget values (computed by the same statics as today), `exposure` (.localNetwork on iOS), and closures for the things the writer pulls from the backend: `playbackPositionProvider`, `isSourceOutageActive`. MOVE requestVODProducerRestart + vodRestartCoalescer + activeVODWriterBaseIndex/HeadIndex + vodPlanForCurrentSource/loopbackVODPlan/loopbackVODPlanSourceURL INTO the host as `requestProducerRestart(atSegmentIndex:authoritative:)` (inventory-3 section 4.4) and leave the backend calling `host.requestProducerRestart`. MOVE verbatim (character-for-character bodies): startSiloLoopback steps 1-11 (B:1979-2062) as `func start() async throws` that resolves with the playlist URL choice from handleFirstSegmentReady B:2265-2290 (server resourceURL / external-URL decision; NOT the display-criteria/attach part, which stays in the backend and receives the URL), startSiloLoopbackWriter + all 13 callback wirings (B:2070-2262) as `func startWriter(vodBaseIndex:recycledInput:)`, ensureLoopbackSubtitleTap (B:2086 region), and the loopback half of teardownMediaPipeline (B:4542...: segmentWriter nil + 7 writer callbacks, segmentServer stop/nil, segmentStore nil, latestLoopbackGeneratedStats, sessionDirectory + `writer.stop(completion: disposeSessionDirectory)` honoring keepArtifacts; loopbackEdgeWatch stays in the backend) as `func teardown()`. Every former backend callback that the writer/store/server fired (onFirstSegmentReady, onSegmentPlanResolved, onSegmentAppended, onVODProducerAnchored, onFinished, onSourceDownloadStats, onGeneratedMediaStats, onBridgedAudioAnchored, onHDR10PlusMetadataDetected, subtitle tap tracks/cues, bitmap tap...) becomes a closure property on the host (`var onFirstSegmentReady: (URL) -> Void`, etc.) that the backend sets -- same shape as today, same ordering. The session guard `activeLoopbackSessionID == sessionID` is REPLACED by the host's own lifetime: a torn-down host nils its closures; the backend keeps `loopbackHost: LocalHLSHost?`, sets it nil in teardown, and every closure the backend installs guards `self.loopbackHost === host` instead of the string compare. Delete `activeLoopbackSessionID` and `loopbackGeneration` from the backend (the store's `generation:` init argument receives a host-local counter or a UUID-derived value -- keep the store API unchanged).
STEP 2. AVPlayerBackend keeps: attachLoopbackItem(url:), finishPreparingAssetPlayback ordering, display criteria (applyTVDisplayCriteriaForLoopbackIfNeeded + settle task), reloadEstablishedLoopbackItem, reloadLoopbackStartupItem, performVODStallRecovery (calls `host.requestProducerRestart(atSegmentIndex:authoritative:)` where it called requestVODProducerRestart), the six ladders UNCHANGED (wave 2b), the recovery handshake UNCHANGED, `isLoopbackHost`, the budget statics (`vodRetentionBudget*`), the initial-video-display gate, audio session, PiP/AirPlay, seek deadline. `startSiloLoopback(sessionSpec:)` becomes: build `LocalHLSHost`, install closures, `Task { await host.start() }` -> on URL: the former handleFirstSegmentReady tail (criteria + attach). `load(strategy:)`'s loopback arm and `selectAudioTrack`'s loopback rebuild keep calling the same entry point.
STEP 3. Tests: iosApp/Tests/LocalHLSHostTests.swift -- construct a host with a real `LoopbackSegmentStore`/`LoopbackSegmentServer` (already tested standalone; see LoopbackSegmentServerRangeTests) and a writer factory you can stub (if the writer cannot be constructed without FFmpeg input, test `teardown()` releases store/server/closures and removes the session directory unless keepArtifacts; test the restart coalescing path with an injected `LoopbackRestartCoalescer`; test the playlist-URL choice incl. the AirPlay external-URL branch). >=6 tests. Extend LoopbackSegmentWriterVODContinuityTests ONLY if a moved callback changes its observable order (it should not).
STEP 4. Build all three schemes; full suite (baseline = tip count + your tests) on your own cloned simulator; take a same-host control at the base SHA. Greps the reviewer runs (0 hits in iosApp/iosApp): `activeLoopbackSessionID`, `loopbackGeneration`, `startSiloLoopbackWriter(`, `requestVODProducerRestart(` outside Engine/LocalHLSHost.swift.

HARD BOUNDARIES: no change to any ladder, timer, threshold, or the recovery handshake (wave 2b); no VM edits; no writer/store/server/ISOBoxSurgery/cutter/plan edits; every moved body byte-identical except the session-guard substitution; SILO_KEEP_DV_HLS read once at host init (design section 7.2 -- list it in behavior_changes); telemetry log lines unchanged.
